plugin.name: Play_Random_Sound
plugin.author: Nick Gammon
plugin.purpose: Plays a sound from a group of sounds
plugin.description:
Implements an interface for other plugins, or triggers etc. to play a sound chosen at random.
Examples of use:
-- loop a battle sound in buffer 9 at -6 db check (CallPlugin ("461479af5d149307e69e305f", "PlayRandomSound", "9,battle,y,-6"))
-- play a single dagger sound in first free buffer at full volume check (CallPlugin ("461479af5d149307e69e305f", "PlayRandomSound", "0,dagger,n,0"))

muclient.script:
sounds = {}
-- args are: buffer,folder,loop,level
function PlayRandomSound (args)
local buffer, folder, loop, level = string.match (args, "^(%d+),%s*([^,]+),%s*([y|n]),%s*(%-?%d+)$")
if not buffer then error ("Arguments to PlayRandomSound are: buffer,folder,loop(y/n),level, you supplied: " .. args) end -- if
-- if folder not read in yet, go grab it if not sounds [folder] then sounds [folder] = {} -- table of sound file names
-- Debug: mostrar caminhos local world_dir = GetInfo(74) ColourNote("yellow", "black", "DEBUG: World dir = " .. world_dir) ColourNote("yellow", "black", "DEBUG: Folder = " .. folder)
-- Ajustar caminho baseado no diretório atual local full_path if folder:match("^sounds/") and world_dir:match("sounds[/\\]*$") then -- Se world_dir já aponta para sounds/ e folder começa com sounds/, remover sounds/ do folder local relative_folder = folder:gsub("^sounds/", "") full_path = world_dir .. relative_folder .. "/*wav" elseif folder:match("^sounds/") then -- Se folder começa com sounds/ mas world_dir não está em sounds/, subir diretório local mushclient_dir = world_dir:gsub("[/\\]worlds[/\\]*$", "") full_path = mushclient_dir .. "/" .. folder .. "/*wav" else -- Caminho relativo normal full_path = world_dir .. folder .. "/*wav" end
ColourNote("yellow", "black", "DEBUG: Full path = " .. full_path)
local t = assert (utils.readdir (full_path))
-- copy from keys of the table of names, into a new table, dropping files starting with "." for k in pairs (t) do if k:sub (1, 1) ~= "." then table.insert (sounds [folder], k) end -- not temporary files end -- for adding each one
-- check we got something assert (#sounds [folder] > 0, "No sounds in folder " .. folder)
ColourNote ("white", "green", "Found " .. #sounds [folder] .. " sounds in " .. folder .. " folder.") end -- if not dagger sounds table yet
-- choose one local random_file = sounds [folder] [math.random (#sounds [folder])]
-- Construir caminho do arquivo para reprodução (mesmo lógica da leitura) local world_dir = GetInfo(74) local sound_path if folder:match("^sounds/") and world_dir:match("sounds[/\\]*$") then -- Se world_dir já aponta para sounds/ e folder começa com sounds/, remover sounds/ do folder local relative_folder = folder:gsub("^sounds/", "") sound_path = world_dir .. relative_folder .. "/" .. random_file elseif folder:match("^sounds/") then -- Se folder começa com sounds/ mas world_dir não está em sounds/, subir diretório local mushclient_dir = world_dir:gsub("[/\\]worlds[/\\]*$", "") sound_path = mushclient_dir .. "/" .. folder .. "/" .. random_file else -- Caminho relativo normal sound_path = folder .. "/" .. random_file end
-- play it check (PlaySound (buffer, sound_path, loop == "y", level ))
end -- function PlayRandomSound
math.randomseed (os.time ())
